content: A-mutikidgine, rey geg gabe gualid. Degisoggu, e-yargi-ibmar-gusmalad-garda-narmakar-mamaid, degi, reymar-ibmar-imaksad-garda-narmakar-mamaid ega sedamalaga imaksad, adi, ega absomalagar.
Geb a-gardagine narmakar-nai dakarmalad, igi Mardoqueo, reyga-nakulemad-e-dummagan-warbogwad Bigtán, degi, Teres-barsogsagusa. Deunni, wemar Rey-Asuero-oburgwega igar amisgusad.

Geb agine, rey egichialid: —Mardoqueo, weyob ibmar-imaksad-ulale, ¿ibu ibmar-nued ega uklesa? Reyga-arbamalad, degi, e-sordamar-idudimalad, reyga sogdemalad: —Dummad-Rey, we-dulega ibmar-nued uklessuli.
Deyob sunmaknanaidgine, Amán reyneg-imbagi dognonikid, adi, Reyse-egisega, suar-ogwichisadgine dukargi-edinnar Mardoqueo-bannu-bannu nasikye. Degisoggu, rey egisdesunnad: —¿Doa we neg-imbagi gudii?
Reyga-arbamalad reyga sogdemalad: —Dummad, Amán neg-imbagi gudii. Geb Rey sogded: —Ega be sogmar, be dogdaye.

Amán dognonigua, Rey-Asuero ese egichided: —An dule-wargwen-nug-odummobiele, ¿Igi an a-dule imakoe? Amán na binsaded: “¿Rey, doa-dule-nug-odummobisunna? Unnila an-nugbi odummolegergebed, geg dule-baid-nug odummoleged.”
be-mor-yosad, degi, be-moli-birgi-sigisad ega sedamala. Deginbali, a-dule-nonogi reyyobi ologurgin ega sibaloed.

Geb we-ibmarmar reyga-arbaed-e-dummad-wargwenga uklegoed, adi, dule-nug-odummolenaidga reymor-yosad yoegar. Deginbali, rey-moli-birgi-sii neggwebur-galimbaba sedbaloed. Agi, reyga-arbaed-e-dummad dule-nug-odummolenaid-iduar binnasuli gornadapi guoed: ‘¡Weyobi, rey, dule-nug-odummobied, imaked!’

Geb Rey-Asuero, Amánʼga sogded: —Gwae be mor sunae, degi, be moli sedabalo. Ar igi na be ibmar-sogsadyobi, Judío-dule-Mardoqueo reyneg-yawagakgi-siidi, deyob be imaknae. Bela na be ibmar-sogsadi, mer be soggwensaar imaksuli guo.

Degisoggu, Amán reymor susad, degi, rey-moli searbalid. Geb Amán Mardoqueoʼga mor-yosad. A-sorbali, Amán moli-birgi Mardoqueo-onakwisad, geb galimbaba sesad. Agine, Amán, Mardoqueo-idunadapi, weyob binnasuli gornadapi gusad: “¡Weyobi, Rey, dule-nug-odummobied, imaked!”
Weyob-gusad-sorbali, Mardoqueo gannar reyneg-yawagakse nonikid. Amánʼdi, bela-bela bukib-itoge, na bingegudedba wagar-odukuar gwae-gwae e-negse nadsunnad.

Geb Amán e-ome-Zeresʼga, degi, e-aimarga bela we-ibmar-gusadi sogsa gusad. Geb Amánʼga dulemar-ega-binsaed-daked, degi, e-ome-Zeres sogdemalad: “Ar Mardoqueo-abin be-nug-bipi-gudedi, we-dule, Judío-dule-guele, mer egi be nakodeeye binsao. Aka bur bule ese be galakuoed.”
Amba wemar Amánʼbo sunmaknanaidgine, reyga-arbamalad nonimalad, geb Ester-mas-imaknaidse gwae Amán-sesmalad.
